question: In which of the following years was the Bengal Sati Regulation enacted?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1829**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Bengal Sati Regulation** was enacted in **1829** by the Governor-General of India, **Lord William Bentinck**.
 
• This regulation was aimed at abolishing the practice of **Sati**, where widows were forced or voluntarily burned alive on their deceased husband’s funeral pyre.
 
• The regulation declared the practice of Sati illegal and punishable by the courts of law.
 
• The enactment was a result of efforts by reformers like **Raja Ram Mohan Roy**, who strongly opposed the practice and advocated for its abolition.
